semiconductor_relevance: High — ClassOne Technology specializes in semiconductor processing tools, particularly for ≤200mm substrates, catering to budget-conscious manufacturers.
summary: ClassOne Technology provides affordable electroplating, wet process, and refurbished semiconductor processing tools, with a focus on ≤200mm substrates. Their offerings include advanced single-wafer tools and batch processing equipment, serving a diverse range of semiconductor manufacturers globally.
capabilities: Wet-chemical processing tools including spin-rinse-dryers and spray solvent tools
Refurbished semiconductor processing equipment from major brands
Turnkey solutions including installation and support

regional_presence.United States: Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with a technology division in Kalispell, Montana.
